author: Thermetrics
versionDescription: Aki is now auto-added as a follower on every new Lead and Opportunity (all 3 creation paths: New Lead, New Opportunity, and Start Opportunity from a converted lead). Also reduced background auto-refresh load: was forcing a fresh insight recompute every 5 min flat; now 20 min + up to 5 min random jitter per cycle, to avoid stacking up with other dashboards and tripping the workspace API rate limit.
